description.value: Nagomi Sushi is a takeaway-only Japanese restaurant in Golden, BC, a popular stop on the Trans-Canada cycling corridor between Banff and Revelstoke. As a takeout-only spot, it offers a quick and convenient meal option for cyclists passing through town without needing to linger at a table.
